import os

workspace=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689869/attempts/bb90a5c04b7e45689f74d9e2a14a4f73/system/state/workspace')
programs=workspace/'programs'; programs.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    marker = 5 if any(5 in row for row in grid) else 4
    fill = 3
    # Draw between every pair of markers in each row.
    for r in range(h):
        cols = [c for c, value in enumerate(grid[r]) if value == marker]
        for left, right in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            for c in range(left + 1, right):
                out[r][c] = fill
    # Draw between every pair of markers in each column.
    for c in range(w):
        rows = [r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c] == marker]
        for top, bottom in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
            for r in range(top + 1, bottom):
                out[r][c] = fill
    return out
'''
